# Original LEZAC.EXE level-1 actor terrain-contact / player-contact evidence.
#
# Captured in-container: 1459 consecutive game ticks sampled tick-locked on the
# frame counter DS:0x78C2, ONE 64 KiB pread of the whole data segment per tick
# so no record can tear across the scattered tables.  The player was driven by
# hand with the original's own controls (z/x/m/c).
#
# EXOGENOUS columns -- fed INTO the replay, never checked against it, because
# the port cannot reproduce a human:
#   px= py=      the player's position (writes port player_.x / player_.y)
#   seed=        ONLY on the 4 ticks listed in exogenous_seed_frames below; on
#                every other tick the seed is CHECKED, not written
#   energy= lives=  ONLY on the 29 ticks flagged hole=1; elsewhere CHECKED
#
# REPLAYED columns -- produced by live port code and checked every tick:
#   cd= bud= liv=   the spawner countdown / budget / live-slot bytes
#   mons=           slot@x:visual_y:anim_frame for each live walker
#   seed=           on the 1455 non-exogenous ticks, including both spawn ticks
#   energy=         on the 1429 scored transitions
#
# `visual_y` is the VISUAL y.  The collision-space y is visual_y - actor[+0x14]
# = visual_y - 6.  `anim_frame` is the BOMOMIMK frame index decoded from the
# visual sprite word as (word - 3698) / 170; the remainder is 0 on 2370/2370
# samples and the four observed values are 43..46 (43,44 = left pair, 45,46 =
# right pair).
#
# `cd` is the live countdown byte at record +0x1B of the ONE-BASED DS:0x74A8
# spawner table (index 1 = the level-1 kind-0x50 spawner); +0x1C = 0x5A reload,
# +0x1D = 3 anim delay, +0x09 = spawn budget, +0x0A = free live slots.
#
# energy_lag_ticks=1 is a property of the SAMPLER, not of the original's damage
# pipeline: the pread happens before the tick's write to DS:0x79EC, so a contact
# on frame F shows as energy[F+1] == energy[F] - 1.  Scoring at lag 0 gives
# 1414/1429; at lag 1 it gives 1429/1429.  Do NOT read this as evidence that the
# original defers damage, and do NOT make the port defer anything.
#
# hole=1 marks the 29 ticks in the two runs 1357..1367 and 1428..1445 where the
# recovered contact predicate fires and the original took no damage.  These are
# the death sequence and the post-respawn immunity -- BOTH OUT OF SCOPE.  The
# interval lengths (11 and 18) are DATA EXCLUSIONS, not a claim about the
# re-entry gate.  They are the ONLY 29 disagreements in all 1458 transitions.
